stations.title: Last night
stations.text: A branch deleted, main reset too far.
stations.note: The log shows none of it.

captions: Pavel needs his harbour-alerts branch. Ines wants the storm wording live today.
Last night you deleted it and reset main too far. The log shows none of it.
You write the commands that bring the work back, in two tasks.
The branch is back with all three commits, and main has its notes again.
Nothing was really lost. It was only hidden.
